data.description: The slam attack--as well as any other natural attacks--of a plague zombie carries the zombie rot disease. Zombie rot: slam; save Fort DC %1; onset 1d4 days; frequency 1/day; effect 1d2 Con, this damage cannot be healed while the creature is infected; cure 2 consecutive saves. Anyone who dies while infected rises as a plague zombie in 2d6 hours.
